detailed_description: ESLint Config Generator creates a starter .eslintrc.json file in the browser from a small set of form controls. Choose a framework from Vanilla JavaScript, React, Vue, or Next.js; choose a style guide from ESLint Recommended, Airbnb, Standard, or Google; optionally enable TypeScript; toggle Browser, Node.js, and ES2021 environments; and set five common rules (no-console, no-debugger, eqeqeq, curly, semi) to Off, Warn, or Error. Click Generate to preview formatted JSON, then copy it or download .eslintrc.json. The tool does not inspect your project, install packages, validate plugin compatibility, support Angular, configure Prettier, or expose arbitrary ESLint rules.
usage_steps: Choose a framework: Vanilla JavaScript, React, Vue, or Next.js
Choose a style guide: ESLint Recommended, Airbnb, Standard, or Google
Toggle Browser, Node.js, and ES2021 environment flags
Set the listed common rules to Off, Warn, or Error
Click Generate to create the .eslintrc.json preview
Copy the JSON or download it as .eslintrc.json
usage_examples: Create a starter React config with TypeScript and react recommended settings
Generate an Airbnb-based config for a small browser project
Turn on the Node.js environment flag for a backend starter config
Set no-console to warn before copying the JSON into your project
